items.label: la prothèse
items.scene: A smiling runner jogs past on a shiny curved PROSTHESIS ("proh-TEHZ") blade, giving the nurses a wave.

items.label: la réanimation
items.scene: A cartoon heartbeat line on the monitor bounces back up like a RE-ANIMATED ("ray-ah-nee-mah-SYOHN") cartoon, and the patient teddy wakes up smiling in INTENSIVE CARE.

items.label: l'infiltration
items.scene: A nurse explains the knee INFILTRATION ("an-feel-trah-SYOHN"), a gentle injection, to a footballer with an ice pack on his knee, a capped syringe prop in her hand.

items.label: la déjection
items.scene: A brass wall plaque reads DÉJECTION, DROPPINGS (formal word for excrement); a false friend, not English 'dejection'.

items.label: l'insertion
items.scene: A nurse makes a neat INSERTION ("an-sehr-SYOHN"), slipping a fresh page into a patient's chart.

items.label: le préjudice
items.scene: A toy football has knocked a flowerpot off the counter, and the nurse sighs: PRAY, JUDGE ("pray-zhew-DEES") the HARM done!

items.label: l'ambulancier
items.scene: A PARAMEDIC in a hi-vis jacket wheels the AMBULANCE ("ahn-bew-lahn-SYAY") stretcher, a smiling teddy aboard, up to the counter.

items.label: le dam
items.scene: A beaver at the counter holds up the little twig DAM that burst, water dripping: to his great DISMAY and HARM.
